name: Pebble Pop Kingdom
oneLiner: Aim a cannon and smash jars, stones and towers in 3D; candy-kingdom reskin of Royal Smash.

name: Mosaic Spinner
oneLiner: Pixel Flow conveyor loop, but the picture rotates 90 degrees every conveyor lap.

name: Potion Pour Pals
oneLiner: Water-sort puzzle reskinned as cozy potion-brewing creatures pouring glowing potions.

name: Word Avalanche
oneLiner: Swipe-spell word-slot puzzle where used letters vanish and the rest fall, so word order matters.

name: Blockbuster Bots
oneLiner: Tap colored robot shooters from a grid into a 5-slot queue; they blast matching voxel blocks off a rotating 3D sculpture.

name: Drifting Pom-Poms
oneLiner: Fluffy Drop bin-filling, but each bin drifts one cell along a track after every move.

name: Category Crown Solitaire
oneLiner: Solitaire layout of word cards sorted onto category headers within a move limit.

name: Rare Words Daily
oneLiner: Daily 'name something' prompts scored by how rarely other players gave the same answer.

name: Sprinkle Shuttle
oneLiner: Tap color-coded vehicles out of a jam along their routes to collect matching layered sprinkles that fill a mosaic.

name: Swap Shop Screws
oneLiner: Unscrew one object and its parts become the kit you re-screw into a second object.
